### The Prayer of a Righteous Woman
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-january-20-2020.html
Passage: James 5:16
Points:
- God cares about and listens to even our smallest, seemingly trivial requests.
- Prayer is not a complicated ritual; it is an honest declaration of utter dependence on God.
- Unanswered prayers often reflect God's greater wisdom and knowledge of what is best.
- Prayer should be our continuous, first-instinct conversation with God rather than a last resort.

### The Big Leagues
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-november-2-2016.html
Passage: James 5:16-18
Points:
- Believers often mistakenly view Elijah as an untouchable spiritual giant out of our league.
- Scripture deliberately reminds us that Elijah possessed the exact same human nature and frailties we do.
- Elijah experienced real doubts, failures, and discouragement, yet he prayed boldly and fervently.
- Ordinary people can pray with great impact because we serve the same faithful, promise-keeping God.
